model_output.score_comment_short: Research work has useful detail, while the marketing bullets remain brief.
model_output.score_comment_long: The research role names the dataset, tool and study purpose. The credit union role lists activities but leaves your contribution to each one unclear. Adding those details and aligning the opening with the experience would strengthen the read.
model_output.score_plain: A reviewer can see marketing exposure and research work, but may need more detail to judge your fit for a marketing role. The opening also raises a question about management experience that the work history doesn't resolve.
model_output.first_impression: The opening calls you a marketing manager, while the credit union entry is a marketing internship. The research entry is more specific about what you worked on.
model_output.biggest_gap_example: "Helped with the member newsletter" doesn't say which parts you handled, so a reviewer can't tell what you contributed to its production.
model_output.summary: At the credit union, your work spans a member newsletter, social media and branch events. The research role adds a different kind of detail: cleaning survey data from 1,200 dairy farms in Stata makes the work concrete. The listed titles point to an early-career profile, although the opening describes campaign leadership at manager level. Without an example of that leadership, a reviewer may be unsure how to reconcile the two.
strengths: The pricing study bullet names the dataset and Stata, giving a reviewer a clear picture of your research work.
Writing 15 literature summaries shows a defined research deliverable.
Leading tours for groups of up to 25 prospective students gives public speaking a practical example.
gaps: The opening doesn't connect its campaign leadership claim to a specific example in the credit union entry, leaving your level of responsibility unclear.
The marketing bullets name channels and activities but not the content or planning tasks you handled.
The latest listed roles end in May 2024, so the resume doesn't show what you have done more recently.

top_fixes.fix: Revise the opening to match the responsibilities shown, or add a specific credit union campaign example that explains your stated leadership.
top_fixes.why: The manager description and internship title currently leave a reviewer with different impressions of your level.
